author: richburdon
principle: Use the conventional, standard term for a well-known concept (e.g. `prev` for predecessor) rather than a non-standard abbreviation.
fix_shape: rename the field/variable to the standard term

author: mykola-vrmchk
principle: Design a general-purpose protocol or interface to stay agnostic to incidental properties that only happen to hold for the current caller (e.g. contiguity); don't bake in assumptions the type doesn't guarantee.
fix_shape: keep the protocol general instead of assuming a caller-specific invariant

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Reuse the existing query mechanism instead of building a new bespoke iteration/cursor API for the same purpose.
fix_shape: replace the custom traversal with a call to the existing query() method

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Type an identifier parameter with its specific branded ID type (e.g. `ObjectId`) rather than a generic `string`.
fix_shape: change the parameter type to the specific branded ID type

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not expose internal-only fields or types through the public API surface.
fix_shape: remove the internal fields from the public interface or move them to an internal-only type

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Define an object's instance type in its own domain module/namespace rather than centralizing all instance types under one generic namespace.
fix_shape: move the type definition to its own module and reference it as `Module.Type`

author: richburdon
principle: Name a function or property to reflect precisely what it returns or does, not a related but different concept.
fix_shape: rename it to match the actual behavior

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Use the field or mechanism specifically built for a purpose instead of overloading a different one that is intended for another purpose.
fix_shape: reference the correct existing field for the concern instead of repurposing another one

author: dmaretskyi
principle: A factory or constructor function should take an options object with optional fields and sensible defaults rather than requiring every caller to pass full configuration.
fix_shape: change the signature to accept a single options object with optional properties

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Before adding a lookup or mapping method to bridge two identifiers, consider whether asserting an invariant (e.g. that the two IDs are equal) would eliminate the need for it.
fix_shape: assert the invariant and remove the extra mapping method

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Keep a namespace's exports consistent with its name's meaning; don't put instance/data types under a namespace intended only for type constructors or introspection.
fix_shape: move the misplaced export to the module whose semantics match it

author: richburdon
principle: Name event handler props/functions consistently using the established `on`/`handle` + Noun + Verb pattern.
fix_shape: rename the handler to follow the on/handle-NounVerb convention

author: richburdon
principle: Always use braces around if-statement bodies, even single-line ones.
fix_shape: add braces around the if body

author: richburdon
principle: Co-locate a component's root and its tightly-coupled context provider/hook in the same file rather than splitting them across files.
fix_shape: merge the files into one

author: richburdon
principle: Name an internal component/export after its public API name rather than a separate internal name, so the two stay consistent across the codebase.
fix_shape: rename the component to match its public API naming

author: richburdon
principle: Avoid long hooks full of defensive non-null checks on their inputs; factor the logic out so the hook's inputs are well-typed and don't need such guards.
fix_shape: extract the logic into smaller, well-typed functions/hooks instead of stacking null checks

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When constructing a resolver for a reference, scope its context to the space of the object holding the reference, not the space of the object it points to.
fix_shape: use the referencing object's own space when building the ref resolver context
